frontDevelopmentPhase.title: Finances, credits et interface AF
frontDevelopmentPhase.goal: Developper les vues financieres client/formateur et l'interface AF sans bloquer les phases pedagogiques precedentes.

allowedMocksUntilDependenciesExist.item: Payment provider can be mocked in non-production.
Legal signature state can be mocked until legal-document-service phase if needed.

frontTests.item: Financeur sees balance, funding plan and payment confirmation.
Teacher submits payment request with invoice state.
AF validates a teacher payment request.
Financial archives filter and download actions are visible.
Non-financeur student sees only allowed balance summary.

apiGatewayImpact.item: Route finance endpoints with strict auth.
Prepare payment callback exception only if provider requires it.

definitionOfDone.item: Financial state can support member/validated account logic.
AF has first usable finance workspace.

frontDevelopmentPhase.workingRule: Developper par tranche verticale: API minimale reelle, ecran utilisable, tests front, verification navigateur, puis phase suivante.
